# Naepo real-yardage conversion

1. Collect published full-course/aerial source imagery.
2. Identify actual 9-hole geometry and two-green structure.
3. Build per-hole real-shape crops without inventing geometry.
4. Apply V1.13 concept-art stylization to the real-shape crops.
5. Keep meter-only UI, direct pulsing orange GPS marker, circular hole navigation, scorecard and offline field calibration.
6. Build and emulator-verify a Naepo Real Yardage APK.
